Tail Quirk.name: Tail Quirk
Tail Quirk.description:
🥋 You have a thick, muscular tail with a tufted tip.

🌱 At the start you balance, brace, block or strike with your two-meter tail, briefly supporting your own weight.
📈 With training: trips, holds, vaults, rescue catches, forceful turns that drive martial arts strikes.
⚠️ Your tail needs room to swing, cannot stretch or detach, and feels pain; pinning it limits movement, and heavy loads strain your lower back.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Bodily Toll, as impacts and heavy lifts strain your tail and its base.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Mashirao Ojiro's Tail. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Mobility +10, Acrobatics +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Rear Brace, Tufted Strike
Tail Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: 2 m muscular tufted tail. Start: balance, brace against shoves, strike or block in reach, briefly bear their weight. Safe vaulting, lifting an adult, martial-arts combos need training. Conditioning adds strength, never length or number.
Limits: flesh: normal pain and injury; trapped or hurt, it hampers movement; overloads strain the lower back. Needs swing room; cannot stretch, split, detach, see or act alone. No automatic martial arts or armor. Tight seats, doorways, trains need care.
Quirk Strain: light: bracing, single strike; moderate: trip, hold, vault, rescue catch; heavy: repeated turning blows, loaded crossing; severe: signature combination, long fights or rescues.
Drawback: built in, the canon Bodily Toll.
Canon: Mashirao Ojiro's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Mutant.
Law: tail strikes and restraints are the user's own, needing a license or self-defense.
Look: tufted tail.
